text.tspan: Estimated share of nuclear warhead stockpiles 1945 to 2026
Stockpiles include warheads assigned to military forces, but exclude retired warheads queued for

tspan.tspan: The exact number of countries' warheads is secret, and the estimates are based on publicly available information, historical records, and

text.tspan: occasional leaks. Warheads vary substantially in their power.
